column1: # P05 blind shape transcription, transcriber B (no key, no values). Pages F74_A0000443 (27 body lines) and F74_A0000444 (6 cipher lines + clear closing).

# Line numbering: body lines only (glosses, folio no., address/endorsement excluded). 443: L01 clear ("Giunsi stamani..."), L02 clear with a short cipher run at the end, L03-L27 cipher. 444: L01-L06 cipher, L07 onward clear (closing, date, subscription).

# Tokens: Fxx = CATALOGUE_F shape; "?" = doubtful (one choice given). Images are low-res JPEG (signs ~12-15 px high): many F12/F16, F25/X:9, F11/F23/F32, F13/F01/F36, F09/F24 calls are uncertain even without "?".

# Conventions: ÷ with both dots=F13, bar+dot below=F01, bar+dot above=F36; bar with small a/loop on it=F24; o with tail to the right=F23; all q/9/g forms with descender=F25 (X:9 not used); "11"=F14; plain "6"=F12; b/6 with crossbar on a stem rising above the bar=F39; leading stroke before ⊥ (–⊥) read as F17 alone.

# X legend: X:5 = 5-shaped sign (flat top flag + open bowl/ʒ-body; frequent; may overlap F39/F19/F27 at this resolution); X:A = Ꝺ/∂-like "A" sign (closed loop with back stroke); X:B = B; X:L = L; X:⁹ = small 9 written above an L (L⁹ group); X:° = superscript small o (after ʃ, 5, π...); X:ʃ = long-s/ʃ sign (always in group 9 ʃ °); X:2 = numeral-2 sign; X:ᶜ = superscript small c (in group 2 ᶜ); X:ω = ω-shaped sign; X:ψ = trident ψ; X:λ = λ; X:∇ = triangle with top bar; X:F = F; X:N = N; X:θ = barred oval θ; X:l = tall l/vertical stroke; X:~ = wavy stroke; X:bar = isolated dash; X:! = vertical stroke with bar below/dot above; X:d = d without stroke.
# K legend: K:HH = double/triple-stem crossed group (# / ǂǂ / H); K:⊙ = circled (or boxed) dot.

# Remarks: 443-03 starts with "~⊥" (X:~ kept). 443-10-1: the last sign F25? may belong to clear "mi dixe" (g?). 443-09-1 ends with a struck/blotted sign after the final m (not transcribed). 443-19-1: "A 8" after L⁹ is heavily inked / possibly struck through (transcribed); a large ink dot after "÷" before "v 4 11" was ignored as blot/punctuation; final dash after 11 transcribed as F13?. 444-05-1 start overlapped by the gloss above (first 3 tokens doubtful). Superscript 6 in 443-06 and 443-17 transcribed as F12 in reading order.
